title: The canary was right: PreToolUse became classic.PreToolUse
description: The CC Contract Probe went red daily from 2026-09-09. Claude Code 2.1.266 and later reject a Function Hooks module that registers bare PreToolUse, and route shell PreToolUse hooks through a classic.PreToolUse dispatch site instead. Replay the probe across versions, with the version bracket and the binary evidence, then see how the fixture now pins the rename from both sides.
